generation_rules.guards: every A define set (single, all-on, cross, packed union) is evaluated against core/six_lane_experiment_guards.mojo and six_lane_ab.combine()
generation_rules.packing: configs from different algorithms share one A build when binding sets are equal, no assigned control reaches another member algorithm (reach = algorithms that declare the control), no member carries a declared global-reach arm, and the union passes the guards
priority: (a) every eligible control alone: each non-default arm / sweep value (child controls carry their parent representative arm)
(b) all-on: one representative arm (first reachable non-default) per control, guard-compatible; controls whose arm breaks the guards are dropped and listed
(c) crosses within each declared interaction group, admitted group-atomically only if the whole group fits the remaining cap
generation_rules.workload_mapping: grid workload -> saved harness ids: classical/more/expanded X -> X@dataset=<taxi|istella> (registered full-input variant replaces a capped original); trees:L -> L:<every saved dataset>; neural:L -> neural:L (bench_board_neural LANES); aliases {"gemm:gemm": "neural:gemm", "neural:cnn-clf": "expanded:cnn-clf"}. verdict_rule.default_state: every switch is NOT MEASURED until then
verdict_rule.identity: tools/six_lane_compare_results.py checks NVIDIA output hash == AMD output hash for the same config. Apple IDENTICAL must also match those hashes; this two-vendor grid alone does not complete three-vendor identity qualification (owner 2026-10-13).
verdict_rule.promotion: combined faster, neither vendor materially slower, identity and quality preserved; then flip the switch in source with the evidence beside it
verdict_rule.quality: the board quality metric must not drop vs B on either vendor
verdict_rule.timing: tools/six_lane_timing.py verdicts: FASTER/SLOWER only when |log(A/B)| of the scored clock exceeds that box's A/A floor for the same workload on BOTH NVIDIA and AMD and both agree in direction; otherwise NO_VERDICT
